verdict.rationale: JumpCloud offers a PowerShell module and REST APIs for bulk/automation tasks, plus a GitHub 'support' repo with API example scripts, but there is no evidence of a dedicated, officially branded CLI tool (e.g., a 'jumpcloud-cli') or any AI-native tooling. missing for 10: an explicit official CLI product, documentation of CLI commands, and any AI-native/agentic CLI features.
